NFL DFS Projections Week 9: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 12:36 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate: 31.9 DraftKings points at $10,000. He also holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Kenneth Walker III second at 37% for $9,000.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Kenneth Walker III (26.8, $9,000), Puka Nacua (23.6, $8,800), Brock Purdy (21.1, $6,800) and Kyren Williams (21.1, $7,600). Jahmyr Gibbs returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.19 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 23.6 for $8,800, Brock Purdy leads the quarterbacks at 21.1 for $6,800, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 19.1 for $7,700.

The 11-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in DAL at IND down to 39.5 in NYG at PHI. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 12:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 9 DraftKings projections

Brock Purdy, SF vs LV ($6,800)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.1 DraftKings points at $6,800, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.6 points clear of Drake Maye. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.10 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 21.1 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 38.5, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 10-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 30.75 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Drake Maye, NE vs GB ($7,000)

Drake Maye projects 2nd at the position with 20.5 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model includes 5.2 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.93 projected points per $1,000, 18th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Maye averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.5 and a ceiling of 37.3, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 2.5-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Daniel Jones, IND vs DAL ($4,700)

Daniel Jones projects for 17.2 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.66 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Jones averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 31.4, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 6-point underdog at home against Dallas, with an implied team total of 22.75 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Running backs: Week 9 DraftKings projections

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET at MIA ($10,000)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 31.9 DraftKings points at $10,000, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.1 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 23.0 carries and 5.3 targets. The salary works out to 3.19 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 31.7 points with a simulated floor of 19.0 and a ceiling of 48.3, and he holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 7-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs NYJ ($9,000)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 26.8 DraftKings points at $9,000, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.5 carries and 3.9 targets. The salary works out to 2.98 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 26.7 points with a simulated floor of 14.3 and a ceiling of 43.9, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR at WAS ($7,600)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.1 DraftKings points at $7,600, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 15.6 carries and 4.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.77 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 39.2, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Washington, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Value: Cam Skattebo, NYG at PHI ($5,600)

Cam Skattebo projects for 16.4 DraftKings points at $5,600, which works out to 2.92 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Skattebo averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 33.2, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Giants are a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Philadelphia, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 39.5.
